transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I keep getting this thought that I missed something when I checked my cab, even when I know I already did the safety check. Like, I’ll be driving or trying to study and it just keeps hitting me that somebody could get hurt, or my boss might think I lied about checking it. I can’t really make it shut up.
How much distress does this recurring thought about missing something in your cab's safety check cause you?

It’s pretty bad. Like, even after I know I checked it, the thought still comes back and I get really worked up that I missed something and someone could get hurt, or my boss will think I lied. It’s hard to turn it off, even when I’m driving or trying to study.
Do you find yourself doing anything over and over to try to make these thoughts about missing something in your cab's safety check go away?

Yeah. Before I take a ride, I keep checking the car again and again — the tires, lights, doors, the meter, the paperwork. Sometimes I’ll take pictures of it too, just to prove to myself I did it. But if it doesn’t feel right, I start the whole check over, even if passengers are waiting and I’m already late.
Do you feel anxious or on edge at times when you're not thinking about the cab's safety check?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to that. Mostly I notice it when that cab-check thought comes up.
Do you often feel anxious or worried about things other than the cab's safety check?
I don’t really know. I mean, I get stressed like anyone, but I haven’t noticed the same kind of worry about other things. It mostly stands out with the cab check.
Do you have any other habits or rituals that you feel compelled to repeat over and over?

Mostly it’s that car check. Before I take a ride, I keep going around the cab checking the tires, lights, doors, the meter, and the paperwork. Sometimes I take pictures too, just so I can feel like I proved I did it. But if it still doesn’t feel right, I’ll start the whole thing over, even if people are waiting and I’m already late.
Do you typically feel anxious or worried when you're not thinking about work or the cab's safety check?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed it much outside of work or the cab stuff. If I’m not thinking about that, I don’t think I’m usually anxious, but I haven’t really paid close attention.
Is your anxiety pretty much limited to thoughts about the cab's safety check?

Yeah, pretty much. It’s mainly that thought that I missed something on the cab, even after I already checked it. I keep thinking someone could get hurt, or my boss will think I lied about checking, and I can’t get it out of my head while I’m driving or even trying to study.
Are there any other situations or things that you obsess about or feel compelled to perform rituals for, outside of the cab's safety check?
No, not really. I can’t think of anything else like that. It’s mainly the cab checking stuff that gets stuck in my head.
Is there anything else, besides the cab's safety check, that you think about repeatedly or feel like you need to do over and over?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I can’t think of anything else I have to keep doing over and over like that. It’s really just the cab safety check thing.
Has your repeated checking of the cab's safety and the thoughts about missing something affected your relationships or work performance?

Yeah, it has. I’ve lost rides because I can’t get myself on the road on time after checking, and I’ve gotten warnings for it. It eats up so much of my day that my CDL studying keeps getting pushed back too. And with friends… I barely see them now, because I’m either behind on work or trying to catch up from all the delays.
Is there anything else that you think about or worry about as much as the cab's safety check?

No, it’s really that same thing. Even after I know I checked the cab, the thought keeps coming back like, what if I missed something and someone gets hurt, or my boss thinks I lied about doing it. It gets stuck in my head when I’m driving or even when I’m trying to study.
Have you noticed any significant problems in your personal relationships or daily life outside of work due to these thoughts or checking behaviors?

Yeah, outside of work too. I barely see my friends anymore because I’m usually behind from all the checking, or I’m trying to catch up on stuff I missed. And my studying for the CDL keeps getting pushed back because so much of the day gets eaten up. It just kind of takes over more than I want it to.
Are your obsessive thoughts and compulsive checking behaviors limited to work-related tasks or do they also occur in other areas of your life?

It’s mostly tied to the cab safety check, yeah. Like even after I know I did it, the thought keeps coming back that I missed something and somebody could get hurt, or my boss will think I lied about checking it. It doesn’t really shut off, even when I’m driving or trying to study.
Have these thoughts and checking behaviors affected any other parts of your life besides work and relationships with friends?

Yeah. It’s hurt other stuff too. I’ve lost rides because I can’t get on the road on time, and I’ve gotten warnings for being late starting because I’m still checking. And my CDL studying keeps getting pushed back because so much of the day gets taken up by it. Then when I’m done, I’m usually just trying to catch up on everything I’m behind on.
Are there any other areas of your life where you feel like these thoughts or checking behaviors are causing problems for you?

Yeah, mostly the same stuff keeps spilling over. I lose rides because I’m not ready to get on the road, and I’ve gotten warnings for starting late. My CDL studying is behind too because so much of the day gets eaten up with checking. And honestly I barely see my friends now, because if I’m not behind on work, I’m trying to catch up from the delays.
Do these thoughts about missing something in your cab's safety check feel like they are forcing their way into your mind, even when you don't want to think about them?

Yeah. It feels like it just forces its way in. Even when I know I already did the safety check, the thought hits me again that I missed something on the cab and someone could get hurt, or my boss will think I lied about doing it. I don’t want to be thinking about it, but I can’t really make it stop, even when I’m driving or trying to study.
